Episode 231. Determination (2)
"Huuuu...."
Veradin regulated his breathing as he looked down. He was standing in the middle of the shield he had formed over the entire Drakka.
Around the shield, ashes whirled like a thick sandstorm. These were the corpses of the demons that had been burned by Veradin's magic.
Although all the wizards of the Ziphil main house were involved in the defense, in reality, he alone had annihilated the demons that had invaded Drakka.
Satrien, along with the Ziphil's leaders and top wizards, only dealt with the demons that occasionally broke through the shield.
Thanks to this, despite the opening of a rift of such scale, no citizen of Drakka was harmed. There were no casualties among the civilians, not even the injured.
However, Veradin did not seem satisfied at all. Rather, his narrowed eyebrows were trembling as if he was having difficulty controlling his anger.
"You've worked hard, master."
Satrien, who had climbed up on the shield, stood next to Veradin. She was watching Veradin's expression for a while.
"Master, are you okay?"
"What about the Baakl Autonomous Region, and the other areas that were invaded?"

"We're still confirming, but there are no areas that were defended as perfectly as Drakka. As initially reported, the Kingdom of Fellin practically suffered a destruction-level damage, and in the Baakl Autonomous Region, we estimate that there were more than 50,000 civilian casualties along with about a hundred federal magicians. And the rest are...."
Satrien continued her report for a while. Each time, Veradin's expression grew darker.
"Kelriak's fiery spirit is unbelievably unpleasant."
"…Excuse me?"
"I thought I had completely erased his shadow..."
Erased the shadow.
As he said, Veradin had considered that his Ziphil had become much more powerful than Kelriak's Ziphil. He claimed to possess superior magic and governance skills than Kelriak.
But now, reading the remaining fiery spirit from the demons that surely had become Kelriak's minions and escaped from the rift, his confidence was wavering.
'The Ziphil of Kelriak has become stronger. Perhaps it may have produced the first star-making wizard since the Rioul Ziphil.'
What if the one who had spread the shield wasn't him, but Kelriak?

What troubled Veradin was precisely that assumption. No matter how he thought about it, if it was the current Kelriak, he seemed to have been able to block without any damage not only Drakka but also the nearby most important autonomous regions.
Of course, if he had deployed Elona on the battlefield, Veradin could have achieved even better results.
But without her power, he couldn't shake off the thought that he still couldn't surpass Kelriak.
'Shinu... That disgusting god wouldn't give up on Kelriak till the end. It's clear that they have completely fused.'
Anger surged up like a ball of fire in his chest.
Right now, Veradin was experiencing deep distress. He regretted not being able to completely cut off Kelriak's lifeline in the Tower of Stories that day.
"Kuuk...!"
Suddenly, Veradin grabbed his head. It was a phenomenon that often happened when the side effects of mental manipulation were at their worst.
'Mana reflux... it's a precursor to a rampage!'

At the moment when the startled Satrien tried to think of a countermeasure, a small ship from the Ziphil family appeared to be descending. It was a small ship that had flown hastily from the Ziphil's first Magic Tower, the Tower of Stories.
"Master!"
Elona descended onto the shield, shouting.
Veradin, without even understanding her voice, reflexively reached out with his hand. His eyes were filled with madness.
But Elona, while extinguishing the magic attached to his hand with one hand, carefully wrapped his shoulder.
"Haack, ha...!"
A moment later, Veradin, engulfed in Elona's magic, gasped for breath and regained his senses. His body was soaked with sweat.
"It's okay, master. Didn't I promise to protect you?"
"Elona... you saw my disgraceful state."
"No. It's probably because of the magic from Kelriak's Ziphil. I felt a terrible magic from Drakka all of a sudden and ran here."

Elona had been sitting quietly in the Tower of Stories and had accurately read the magic of Kelriak that had spread far away in Drakka. Satrien thought about what it meant to ascend to the top, newly surprised by her ability.
Then, Elona gathered the fiery spirit of Kelriak that had clung to Veradin's body into the air. It was a flame, strikingly scarlet.
Veradin could only breathe a sigh of relief after it had left his body.
"This is an old curse used by those who manipulate fire."
"A curse...?"
"The curse of fire, a curse that the Fire God Shinu once tried to teach me. It amplifies the distress and turns the target into a beast filled with lust."
Elrona clenched her fist to extinguish the curse of fire.

"Especially effective against changseongs, or those similar to them. I haven't experienced it, but everyone going through that phase is exposed to the heart's devil, so they can't distinguish it from the curse no matter how exceptional their senses are."
Therefore, the curse of fire is the most dangerous curse for those who are going through the stage of the heart's devil.
However, there were many restrictions on its use and there were limits to the number of times it could be used.
"… Then I was just about to be cursed. Thank you, Elrona."
"I'm just relieved I wasn't late. But from now on, you must rest with me for a few days. It's not safe until I find and eliminate all traces of the curse."
"A few days? No, then I can't go to the kingdom myself now, eh!”
All of a sudden! Veradin spat out a chunk of black blood.
'Kelliac, I've been hit hard by that beast.'
Feeling an intense sense of disgust, as if standing on Kelliac's giant palm, he must be smiling somewhere in the demonic world now.
"If you go to the kingdom alone in that state now, you will surely die. Even your old friends who are fighting against Paelito in perfect condition can't hold on."
"Hoo. Do you have some understanding of the battlefield situation in the kingdom?"
"It's serious. The map is changing in real time, and Paelito's magic is amplifying. The speed is so fast that I think it might soon cover the entire kingdom."
"Then the forces of Inse fighting in the kingdom now…"

"The tower predicts that they will definitely lose. However, the tower's calculations are still unstable, and recently most of the calculations related to the demonic world have been wrong. The siege of Grosh and the invasion of Drakka this time, the tower made the wrong calculations."
Elrona locked eyes with Veradin.
His eyes, which were just about to fall into a heart's devil, were not as cold as usual. There was suppressed anger and madness.
And within them, it seemed like there was a faint worry and anxiety.

No, it was clearly visible. Veradin himself didn't know, but Elrona could recognize it. She had a time when she was wandering around the world with the same eyes. It was like looking at herself reflected in the mirror.

'What is the lord worried about? The dizzy heart's devil is bringing out something buried deep in you. It might be fear of Kelliac Jipel... or worry about Jin Lun-Kandel and Dante Hyran. The fear of friends' death...?'
Elrona couldn't know exactly what was in Veradin's trembling eyes. But it's only clear that Veradin is very scared now.
'Whatever it is, one day I will find what you have forgotten. Just as you gave me a new meaning when I was lonely in the world, just as you cherished me, a monster.'
At the moment when she made such a resolve, a faint memory crossed Elrona's mind.
It felt like someone had embraced her when she was like the present Veradin.
"How do you see it, Elrona? Does it match the Tower's calculations?"
"Honestly, when Paelrito woke up, I didn't think anyone except me, the ruler of Runecandel... and two other entities whose identities I don't know yet, could stop that demon."
"Has that thought changed?"
"...I'm sorry, your lordship. I'm not sure."
"No, don't say that."

"Still, if I have to say, I have a feeling that something huge in the Holy Kingdom will wake up again. Like when Baekgyeong was about to return to Runecandel, and the energy of Syron Runecandel came from the Black Sea."
Veradin and Satrin's pupils dilated.
"You mean, Jin Runecandel might ascend during the battle, like the previous Sword Emperor...?"
"That's a future that even Az Mil might not know. Ascension is unpredictable and can twist any fate. But the energy I felt is very dark."
"Dark."
Veradin took a moment to imagine Jin ascending.
It didn't seem possible that the moment would be dark. It was too far removed from the actions Jin Runecandel had shown as a human so far.
"Then it could be the manifestation of Zito's body that the Holy Kingdom is holding. That would certainly be dark as you described, Elrona."
Veradin replied in a somewhat weak voice.

"Paelrito Belgasium might also unlock another power. The certain thing is that whatever wakes up in the Holy Kingdom now, you and I cannot witness it directly. Whether the Barmel Alliance is annihilated, or they manage to protect the Holy Kingdom. We can only respond to whatever happens after the fight is over."
Veradin nodded heavily. There was no need for him to drag his cursed body and go to the Holy Kingdom when Elrona was saying this much.
From Zipel's point of view, the best result was that the Barmel Alliance and the top powers of the Demon Realm would all be annihilated in the Holy Kingdom.
That outcome didn't seem particularly pleasant.
'Did I become sentimental because of the curse? Strangely, I hope Jin Runecandel and Dante Hyran don't die.'
Veradin quickly dismissed that thought and grabbed Elrona's hand.
"Let's go down to the main house first, Elrona. I apologize for keeping you on this dizzying battlefield for too long because I'm not feeling well."
